penjelasan.en: Public service and opening-hour information helps plan a visit; confirm dentist availability before arriving.

fitur_khas.alasan_dipilih: Ulasan publik menyebut pengalaman pembersihan karang gigi; lokasi praktik di Berjo Kulon Godean.

a.id: Lokasi tercatat di Berjo Kulon, Sidoluhur, Kec. Godean, Kabupaten Sleman, DI Yogyakarta 55264. Periksa petunjuk arah sebelum berangkat.
a.en: Listed location: Berjo Kulon, Sidoluhur, Kec. Godean, Kabupaten Sleman, DI Yogyakarta 55264. Check directions before travelling.

a.id: Direktori mencatat Senin–Sabtu 10.00–20.00 WIB; Minggu tutup. Konfirmasi sebelum berkunjung.
a.en: The directory lists Monday–Saturday 10 AM–8 PM WIB, closed Sunday. Please confirm before visiting.

a.id: Silakan gunakan kontak yang tercantum untuk menanyakan jadwal dan ketersediaan tindakan.
a.en: Use the listed contact details to ask about appointments and treatment availability.

a.id: Tarif resmi belum ditemukan. Tanyakan estimasi dan rincian biaya kepada klinik.
a.en: Official prices were not found. Ask the clinic for an estimate and cost breakdown.

a.id: Perawatan kawat gigi tercantum pada direktori. Ketersediaan dokter dan jadwal perlu dikonfirmasi.
a.en: Orthodontic care appears in the directory. Confirm the provider's availability and schedule.
